scope: Visual inspection of the five final PNG figures using view_image; PDF renderings were not separately inspected.
findings: Utility, coverage, and selective-risk plots have readable axes and labels; seed-level points show the substantial variation of RL runs.
The utility plot includes zero and shows that all evaluated methods have negative mean primary utility on NQ.
Calibration curves and risk-coverage curves are readable; the latter use shared generator candidates and retain score ties.
The calibration legend overlaps some original-P(True) points in the lower-right part of the NQ panel. Move this legend in a future publication figure revision.
Seed-specific colors in the primary plots are not individually named in the legend; consult the accompanying tables for identities.
